verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents user-defined rules that fire actions on events, such as alerting rules, watchers or event-triggered actions. The automatic embedding generation on semantic_text indexing is built-in behavior, not a configurable rule-to-action capability. A community remark that alerts sit behind a paid tier does not document the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
